AW9 Rewards Guide: Invitations, Daily Bonuses & Rebates

This guide separates the reward types shown on the homepage. Check the matching event inside your app for eligibility, deadlines and the amount available to your account.

Invitation wheel

The homepage advertises a ₹1,000 bonus per invitation and free spins that reset each day. An invitation bonus and a daily free spin are separate parts of this offer. The wheel image shows possible prize amounts, not an account balance.

Agent invitation rewards

The agent rules shown on this website require the invited user to register through the invitation link or code, deposit at least ₹200 and meet the ₹600 betting requirement. Those rules list ₹100 for the inviter and ₹20 for the invited user.

These agent rewards are a separate event from the invitation wheel. Check which event your invitation belongs to before expecting a reward.

Daily Double Bonus

Your tier is based on yesterday's total recharge. A qualifying tier has a free reward and a separate paid reward that requires a further deposit. If the previous day's recharge does not reach the minimum tier, no reward is available for that day.

For example, the published ₹100–₹299 tier lists a ₹1 free reward and a ₹7 paid reward with a ₹100 deposit requirement. The ₹300–₹999 tier lists ₹3 free and ₹20 paid with a ₹300 deposit requirement.

Daily loss rebate

The published table lists rebate rates from 1% to 2.8%, depending on the loss-rate level. Pending rebates become claimable after settlement. Check the event page for the calculation and your settled amount.

Before claiming or withdrawing

  • Match the reward to its event; conditions are not identical across promotions.
  • Check the deadline and whether a claim is automatic or manual.
  • Review the turnover requirement. The reward-wheel rules on the homepage list 5× turnover before withdrawal.
  • Use the event's claim history to check previous claims.

See help and contact options for an account-specific question, or return to the homepage for the detailed reward tables.
